about.what: Human judgements for the invented-household billboard fixtures. Scored by `den-atlas billboard-eval <dataset dir>` beside the existing slate checks. This file intentionally starts unjudged: relevance must not be guessed from Atlas labels or generated by a model.

grades.good: A strong billboard lead for this household now: relevant to its taste and appropriate for a featured surface.
grades.ok: Defensible, but generic, weakly timed, or less representative of this household than a good slide.
grades.bad: A viewer would read this as a billboard mistake for this household, even if one surface signal overlaps.

about.holdout: Known-good titles deliberately excluded from tuning grades. recall@40 is how many appear in the first 40 divided by every holdout title for that fixture.
about.adding: Run with BILLBOARD_EVAL_UNJUDGED=<file> to export the ranked unknown candidates. A human fills grade and basis, then moves entries into this file. Do not infer a grade from scorer features.
